runs.name: Nippon Yusen Kabushiki Kaisha
runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **¥7,358** (TSE 9101 close 2026-10-09; Tokyo shut 2026-10-12) and ADS **$9.33** (same day), aggregator, flagged; **5 ADS = 1 share** on the company's own ADR page (BNY Mellon, OTC), checked from the two quotes at ¥158.06. Share changes checked from the company's documents: 1-for-10 reverse split 2017-10-01, 3-for-1 split 2022-10-01, treasury cancellations 2026-03-25 and 2026-05-29; Nippon Cargo Airlines left by share exchange with ANA 2025-08-01; Movianto bought for cash. Shares **403,555,618** (issued 405,321,700 less treasury 1,766,082 at 2026-06-30, Q1 tanshin of 2026-08-05) = cap **¥2,969.4bn** ($18.79bn); sovereign **4.085%** (JGB 30Y, Ministry of Finance jgbcme.csv, 2026-10-09). Not an SEC registrant (EDGAR holds only CB, F-X and SUPPL filings to 2009 and ADR forms): `tools/run.py` and `cover_shares.py` returned nothing; every figure by hand from the audited English Financial Results series, the FY2025 tanshin of 2026-05-11, IR Data Book 2026, Fact Book 2018, NYK Report 2025, IR Fact book 2025 and the briefings carrying ONE's own results; operating cash ¥473,358m cross-checked against the audited statement. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the annual report, as the overnight brief directs. **Q1 IN, narrowly**: Liner Trade decides at 62.3% (¥1,916.9bn of ¥3,076.3bn segment recurring profit, years to March 2022-2026), held as the 38% equity-method stake in Ocean Network Express, sixth carrier at 6.4% of capacity against MSC 20.7%; passed on the economics (M2012-065, M2011-014), not the freight rate. **Q2 OUT**: a commodity carrier whose price the field sets ('Freight Decreased due to softer supply-demand balance', ONE FY2025), capacity bought by whoever has the money (M2012-106, M2013-054; ONE's plan to spend over $25bn), no document claims the low-cost position (NYK's own report: 'to close the fleet scale gap with its major competitors'), and the field fell back after the 2020-22 shock (ONE EBIT margin 2.7% FY2023, 1.9% FY2025); 'Buy commodities, sell brands' (L2011-008). Against it, written down: ONE's FY2018-25 profits of $40.3bn, read as the field's price in a shock. Q3 to Q12 not reached. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash after capex, lease principal and net acquisitions ¥240.5bn literal five-year average, ¥74.0bn (¥86.4bn all-equity) over YE Mar 2017-2024 as the cycle base (a choice the analyst states), nineteen-year sum -¥637.9bn (negative every year 2008-2020 but one); growth series changes sign, so the range is one no-growth case **¥2,291 all-equity ($2.90 per ADS)**, ¥4,358 equity-only, literal window ¥13,691; 2.1% at the price central, 6.1% literal; fair price beneath the stop **below zero all-equity (-¥705)**, ¥1,803 equity-only ($2.28), literal window ¥3,716 all-equity; not armed (box not OUT at Q7). Net debt ¥1,135.7bn at 2026-06-30. Balance sheets: equity ratio 24% to 29% to March 2021, a ¥265.7bn loss in the year to March 2017 (a third of equity), equity about sixfold since on the container windfall held mostly as the ONE stake; debt ¥694bn (March 2023) to ¥1,362bn (June 2026) to pay buybacks (¥200bn, ¥125bn, ¥144bn), a ¥390bn dividend and Movianto (goodwill up ¥228bn). Recorded after the stop, not weighed: the company's own note on 'its conspiracy to fix prices of shipping with major automobile shipping companies', antitrust payments about ¥54bn, class actions open; the FY2026 recurring-profit forecast moved ¥185bn to ¥250bn in eleven weeks. Competitors: ZIM the only SEC-filing liner rival (20-F, 0001178913-26-000784), operating margins -0.7% to 54.2% to -48.6% over 2018-2025, negative equity 2017-19, ONE better in the 2023 trough and worse in 2025; MSC, Maersk, CMA CGM, COSCO, Hapag-Lloyd, Evergreen, HMM and Yang Ming flagged as non-filers, not read. Not got: the yuho, the governance report, the 2026 meeting notice, ONE's full statements and FY2018-19 EBIT. Contamination declared by the analyst: the file name of the 2026-07-15 run of this ticker in a directory search (not opened), the session's commit subjects on SSUMY, a memory index line; none used. Commits 43b696d4, b5e8448d, 84bd6c20, 2a25dde7, 01d995b9. Citations: the analyst's check no E-ids, no missing ids; the dispatcher's adjacency script 41 ids resolved, 16 adjacent fragments, 0 slips. Position note filled at the fold. check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) Q1 test 2 ('If something is not very predictable, forget it', M1998-044) and Q2's commodity section overlap for a commodity business, so the same file could close at Q1 TOO HARD (NATURE); the routing paragraph is silent on an unforecastable commodity price (the trading-house runs of today read the same question three ways); (2) Q2's parts threshold is written in operating profit, but a deciding part held through an equity-method affiliate earns below operating profit (the analyst confessed a reading for the run); (3) Q7 specific (a) gives no rule for picking the cycle when owner cash runs negative for a decade then spikes; the choice moved central fair from below zero to ¥3,716.
runs.narr: Q2 OUT: a shipping group whose deciding part (62% of five-year profit) is its 38% stake in Ocean Network Express, sixth container carrier at 6.4% of capacity; a commodity priced by the field, capacity open to anyone with money, no evidence of the low-cost position, and margins back near nothing after the 2020-22 windfall (ONE EBIT 1.9% FY2025). Q1 passed narrowly on the economics. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: owner cash negative in sum over nineteen years, one no-growth case ¥2,291 all-equity at the 4.085% JGB against ¥7,358, fair below zero all-equity (¥1,803 equity-only), not armed. After the stop: the car-carrier price-fixing note and open class actions; debt nearly doubled since 2023 for buybacks, a special dividend and Movianto.
